d.ko: Threefold Recital is set in an oriental fantasy world where the metropolis of Bluescales faces turmoil after a long golden age. The mix of magic, modern, and ancient technologies challenges governance, while tensions between humans, beastlings, and dragons grow. In the shadows, a crisis looms...

d.zh: 《三相奇谈》的故事发生在一个幻想中的东方世界。数千年的繁荣时代早已落幕，人、妖怪、龙族混居的青龙城逐渐步入了道术、机关术以及失落的古代科技并存的混沌年代。黑暗在城邦角落悄然滋生，一次前所未有的危机即将爆发……
